quest_name: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood! (refused the massacre)
outcome: Killed Astrid but refused Commander Maro's order to slaughter the rest of the Sanctuary
citation: B04 tier A, a stage this QE ADDS to vanilla DBDestroy (vanilla has 0/10/20/30/35/40/200/255; the mod adds 25/199): s199 'It turns out I killed Astrid, the leader of the Dark Brotherhood. Commander Maro in Dragon Bridge asked me to kill the rest of the group, but I refused.' Rejected generic reads: uphold_law_justice is NOT applied - refusing an Imperial officer's order is the opposite of serving lawful authority, whatever one thinks of the order. RUNTIME-VERIFY: non-terminal.
branch_note: The expansion's addition: vanilla offers only the full massacre, this adds refusing it. The killing of Astrid itself is vanilla's and belongs to the core matrix, not here.
